title: Memory.mjs Staging Schema
description: Pre-script staging file shape for /321 -SessionUpdate, /321 -MemoryUpdate, and /321 -Update. Claude writes this; `node AIDOCS/tools/memory.mjs commit --skill <skill>` consumes and applies it. Routine ops target only LIFO (and Current State for SESSION, or features/ideas for BACKLOG). The static six MEMORY sections are only reachable via promote_to_section, gap_fill_section, and update_section_text - all mode=full only. CHANGELOG is owned by /321 -AutoPush, not this pipeline.

skill.description: Which skill produced this staging file. Script uses this to pick the right target files and rules.

mode.description: Mode the skill ran in. promote_to_section, gap_fill_section, and update_section_text all require mode=full.

actions.description: Ordered mutations on the main file (SESSION.md or MEMORY.md). Applied in order.

extended_actions.description: Ordered mutations on the EXTENDED file (SESSION_EXTENDED.md or MEMORY_EXTENDED.md). All entries are `### sub-section`s under the `## LIFO` heading.

backlog_actions.description: Mutations on BACKLOG.md (Features / Ideas LIFO sections). memory-update only. Empty / absent for session-update - the validator rejects backlog ops on the session lane.

op.description: overwrite_section: replace SESSION/Current State body entirely. lifo_insert: new bullet at top of LIFO. remove: drop matching LIFO bullet. replace: edit an existing LIFO bullet (remove + lifo_insert). The updated bullet lands at the top of LIFO, signaling recent progress on the underlying thread. promote_to_section: move LIFO bullet to a static MEMORY section (mode=full only). gap_fill_section: draft content into an empty static MEMORY section (mode=full only). update_section_text: surgical substring replace inside an existing MEMORY static section (mode=full only). Used for refine (e.g. 'Astro 4' -> 'Astro 5') or replace (e.g. 'uses Astro' -> 'uses React') of named facts surfaced by SESSION/conversation. Requires rationale.

section.description: Routine-op target slug. current_state=SESSION/Current State (overwrite). lifo=SESSION/LIFO or MEMORY/LIFO. The static six are NOT in this enum - use promote_to_section, gap_fill_section, or update_section_text instead. BACKLOG sections live on backlog_actions.

bullets.description: Used by overwrite_section. Each string becomes one bullet.

bullet.description: Used by lifo_insert and replace. Must be <= 2 physical lines.

match.description: Used by remove, replace, and promote_to_section. Substring (case-insensitive) of the target bullet. Script requires EXACTLY ONE matching bullet - errors with location hints when 0 or multiple bullets match.

extended_anchor.description: Optional. Lowercase-kebab slug. If set, the bullet renders with a `[+]` marker and NO link (`- [+] <bullet text>`); the engine derives the anchor by slugifying the bullet text, so the bullet text must slugify to this value. Must resolve to a staged extended_action or an existing sub-section anchor under the EXTENDED file's `## LIFO` heading. Legacy `[text](file#slug)` links are still recognized on read.

target_section.description: Required for promote_to_section, gap_fill_section, and update_section_text. The MEMORY static section to write into. All three ops require mode=full.

target_decisions.description: Optional for promote_to_section. If true, content lands under the qualified `### <Section> Decisions` sub-section instead of the section's main body.

body_md.description: Required for gap_fill_section. Bullets / prose for the MEMORY static section body.

decisions_md.description: Optional for gap_fill_section. Content for the `### <Section> Decisions` sub-section.

extended_body_md.description: Optional for gap_fill_section. Longer-form prose for the MEMORY_EXTENDED mirror H2 section body.

extended_decisions_md.description: Optional for gap_fill_section. Longer-form prose for the MEMORY_EXTENDED `### <Section> Decisions` sub-section.

find.description: Required for update_section_text. Substring to locate inside the target Big 6 section body. Strict uniqueness - script errors when 0 or >1 matches. Add surrounding context if needed.

replace.description: Required for update_section_text. Replacement text. Can be empty string (deletes the matched substring).

extended_find.description: Optional for update_section_text. Substring to locate inside the MEMORY_EXTENDED mirror H2 section body. If set, extended_replace must also be set. Same strict-uniqueness rule applies.

extended_replace.description: Optional for update_section_text. Replacement text for the MEMORY_EXTENDED mirror. Pairs with extended_find.

rationale.description: Required for update_section_text. One-line explanation of WHY this update applies (e.g., 'package.json shows astro@^5.1.0; SESSION confirms migration'). Surfaces in the commit summary so the user has a clear review trail.

op.description: add: new `### sub-section` under `## LIFO`. drop: remove sub-section. replace: rewrite body of existing sub-section. replace_text: substring swap inside a sub-section body.

anchor.description: Lowercase-kebab slug of the sub-section heading under `## LIFO`.

heading.description: Optional. Pretty sub-section heading text. If absent, derived from anchor (kebab-to-title-case).

body_md.description: Markdown body. Required for add and replace. No fenced code - the validator REJECTS a staged body containing a ``` fence (commit aborts pre-write). Summarize the takeaway in prose, the code lives in the source. Aim ~10 lines, over-length only when the entry is genuinely important.

find.description: Required for replace_text. Substring to locate within the anchor's body. Must match exactly once - commit errors with all location hints when it doesn't.

replace.description: Required for replace_text. Replacement text. Can be empty string (effectively removes the matched text).

op.description: lifo_insert: new bullet at top of the section. remove: drop matching bullet. replace: edit an existing bullet (remove + lifo_insert). The updated bullet lands at the top of its section, signaling recent activity. No overwrite_section - both BACKLOG sections are LIFO, never overwritten wholesale.

section.description: Which BACKLOG section to mutate. features=specific, ready-to-implement-when-committed. ideas=everything-else-future (exploratory, refactor candidates, polish notes).

bullet.description: Used by lifo_insert and replace. Format: `**<title>.** <description> _(source: user|ai-surfaced)_`. Two physical lines max.

match.description: Used by remove and replace. Substring (case-insensitive) of the target bullet. Must match exactly one bullet.
